purpose: Independent, provenance-tagged transcription of the paper's own parameters. Read-only with respect to configs/p2_closed_loop_protocol_v3.json; this file does not change any historical protocol.

paper.title: Cooperative Object Transport and Assembly: Pose/Force Control by Visual-Tactile Feedback
paper.venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, accepted February 2026
paper.note: PDF is private source and is not committed. Values below were read from pages 5-8 (Table I, Table II, Fig.5(d), Section IV) and cross-checked against the rendered page images.

status_legend.UNKNOWN: not given by the paper; must not be silently guessed
status_legend.ADAPTATION: chosen in the simulation because the paper is silent; recorded, not claimed as the author's value

QT_b2b1.note: set to zero during transport (paper: calibration estimated before grasping, then constant)

exp4_model_K1.note: model stiffness used by exp4 (plant intentionally mismatched)

B1.note: Fig.5(d) lists 'B1-B2' as one row, so B1 and B2 share mass and dimensions

robots.value: Kuka LBR iiwa 7 and Yaskawa Motoman SIA5F

tactile_rate_hz.note: two SUN-Touch sensors on a WSG gripper

camera.note: model string kept verbatim from the paper

aruco_fps.note: 4 ArUco markers per object, marker-to-COM offsets measured with a caliper

multi_rate_policy.value: fixed-rate prediction with measurement updates only when fresh data arrive

hosts.value: two Ubuntu 22.04 / ROS2 machines (control and perception)

segment_start_times_s.note: 13 s is printed; 23 s and 55 s are simulation choices

experiment_duration_s.note: internal wrench controllers deactivated at 95 s in the high-moment maneuver

exp1_unnecessary_internal_force_N.printed_as: about 1.5 N throughout most of the motion

final_translation_error_mm.note: below caliper resolution; censored measurement, not an exact zero

high_moment_reduction_percent.note: approximately 80 percent at the end of the maneuver

assembly_angular_errors_deg.note: 5 repetitions; translation below 0.1 mm caliper resolution

assembly_cycle_time_min_per_block.note: decided at planning level, not an algorithmic speed

sliding_grasp_force_N.note: SIA5F grasp force reduced at t = 130 s to enable sliding

unknown_or_unreported: object inertia tensors (the paper only states the object is assumed rigid)
grasp/finger contact coordinates on each object
absolute waypoint poses and the 23 s / 55 s segment boundaries
exact discrete propagation used for Eq.(18) (Euler vs exponential vs implicit is not stated)
grasp-force controller of [23] and friction coefficients needed for Fig.9
soft-pad geometry, preload and deformation limits
marker-to-COM offsets and ArUco dictionary id
calibration sample count and estimator initialization procedure
supplementary video contents and any numeric comparison between IESEKF and a standard EKF
consistency_note: All PAPER values above match configs/p2_closed_loop_protocol_v3.json::original_parameters exactly; the protocol already stores them multiplied out (e.g. 1e-6 instead of diag(1,1,1,10,10,10)*1e-6). No protocol value was changed by this file.
